title: A sixteen-prime-factor bound for Lehmer's totient problem and exact prime-completion criteria - research revision

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
A research revision of the sixteen-prime-factor bound for Lehmer's totient problem. The full conjecture remains unproved.

This version proves by finite search that every composite solution of phi(n) | n-1 exceeds 10^35 (the tree search of the paper with a size rule), that a quotient (n-1)/phi(n) of at least 3 forces at least 18001 distinct prime factors, and that 3 | n forces more than 10^9; the size bounds of Theorem 1.2 are sharpened accordingly. The programs (C with GMP, Python, PARI/GP) and their logs are included, and the paper states which counts were obtained by two programs.

Deep Bhattacharjee is the sole manuscript author; earlier creators retain their bibliography credit. No journal submission, acceptance or full closure is asserted.
